hero.title: The business capabilities you need, in an environment designed around you.
hero.lead: The following are platform capability areas. Exact modules, included functions and release availability depend on the selected plan and approved catalogue.

disclaimer: NELIAS AI, advanced analytics, connectors and sector-specific functions may be optional, usage-based, or scheduled for a later release.

finance-accounting.name: Finance & Accounting
finance-accounting.description: Track financial transactions and support clearer financial operations.

crm-sales.name: CRM & Sales
crm-sales.description: Organize contacts, opportunities, pipelines and customer interactions.

purchasing-inventory.name: Purchasing & Inventory
purchasing-inventory.description: Manage suppliers, purchasing cycles, inventory and warehouse operations.

point-of-sale.name: Point of Sale
point-of-sale.description: Support retail transaction workflows where enabled.

projects-timesheets.name: Projects & Timesheets
projects-timesheets.description: Plan, execute and monitor project-based work.

human-resources.name: Human Resources
human-resources.description: Manage selected people and administrative workflows.

manufacturing-quality.name: Manufacturing & Quality
manufacturing-quality.description: Support production and quality workflows for eligible sector configurations.

assets-maintenance.name: Assets & Maintenance
assets-maintenance.description: Track assets, servicing and maintenance activities.

customer-support-portal.name: Customer Support & Portal
customer-support-portal.description: Support service requests and customer-facing interactions where available.

reporting-analytics.name: Reporting & Analytics
reporting-analytics.description: Turn operational information into usable management visibility.

workflows-automation.name: Workflows & Automation
workflows-automation.description: Connect steps, approvals and notifications across business processes.

connectors-apis.name: Connectors & APIs
connectors-apis.description: Integrate with approved third-party systems and services.
